prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / compositing.
Create a shared character HEIGHT COMPARISON sheet using these two exact reference identities.
Image 1: Damian AF-M01, male, use his FRONT standing view as the identity, proportions and clothing reference.
Image 2: Ola AF-F01, female, use her FRONT standing view as the identity, proportions and clothing reference.
Show exactly TWO full-body people next to each other, Damian on the left and Ola on the right. BOTH stand upright on the SAME horizontal ground line, SAME distance from the viewer, front view, orthographic-like camera without perspective distortion. Neutral relaxed arms down, feet planted, no leaning, no bent knees, no high heels. All heads, hands and shoes fully visible with generous margins. No extra expression panels.
CRITICAL HEIGHT RELATIONSHIP: Ola must be shorter than Damian by approximately HALF OF DAMIAN'S HEAD HEIGHT (crown to chin). Their height difference should be clearly visible but modest, around seven percent of Damian's total height, not a whole head and not equal height. For a 1024px-tall composition, a useful visual target is Damian's shoe soles at y=930 and crown at y=90; Ola's soles also at y=930 and crown around y=150. These are layout guides only, not text to print. Keep both adult head sizes plausible and preserve each person's body shape; do not make Ola a child, compress her legs, or distort her figure to achieve the height difference.
Keep Damian's same specific face, subtle slate blue-grey eyes, short copper-brown beard, brown quiff, ear cuff, charcoal crewneck shirt, charcoal trousers and black shoes. BOTH SHIRT SLEEVES MUST EXTEND FULLY TO HIS WRISTS, no rolled/pushed sleeves, no visible forearms, no tattoos. Hands visible.
Keep Ola's same specific face, blue-green almond eyes, arched brows, chestnut shoulder-length hair with lifted front, blue collared shirt with rolled sleeves as in her own reference, charcoal trousers, plain narrow belt and black flats. The full-length sleeve rule applies to Damian only.
Maintain the reference editorial comic look: clean dark outlines, warm cel shading, consistent facial geometry, restrained highlights. Plain warm ivory background and a single fine grey floor line beneath both pairs of feet. No lettering, no labels, no dimensions, no arrows, no grid, no logos, no props. Preserve facial identities; the requested change is relative height, not new faces.
assessment: Różnica wzrostu za duża, około 0,77 wysokości głowy Damiana; wersja odrzucona jako referencja skali.

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve.
Edit the provided two-person height comparison sheet. The woman is TOO SHORT. Make only this geometric correction: enlarge the WHOLE woman on the RIGHT uniformly by about 5.5%, keeping her feet anchored to the SAME floor baseline. Move her crown upward by approximately 60 pixels in the 1024 x 1536 image, from current y≈287 to target y≈230. Her soles must remain at y≈1370, same as the man.
The man is completely unchanged: his crown is at y≈126 and chin at y≈334. Therefore half of his head height is about 104 pixels, and the woman's crown should be around y=230 (126+104). The current gap of about 160px is too large. Result should be a modest half-head height difference.
Do not change either face, eye colour, facial proportions, hair, beard, ear cuff, expression or clothing. Do not selectively stretch her legs or neck. Preserve the woman's adult proportions by uniformly increasing the entire right-hand figure, including her head. Keep the exact same composition, ivory background, floor line, man's long sleeves fully covering his forearms to the wrists, and the woman's blue shirt and black flats. No new text, lines, labels, arrows or objects. Full bodies still visible.
assessment: Oględziny: czubek głowy Damiana około y=126, podbródek około y=334, czubek głowy Oli około y=238 przy wysokości obrazu 1536 px. Różnica około 112 px, czyli około 0,54 wysokości głowy Damiana. Wspólne podłoże, naturalne sylwetki, pełne rękawy Damiana. Wartości orientacyjne z oględzin, nie pomiar biometryczny. Plansza do wglądu użytkownika.
